lines: Two in the morning, at the railroad crossing

Even the pain of not holding it

I searched for a faint light
The pain I came to know that way
The things I wanted to tell you grew too
Just one thing — I still remember it
Beaten by rain the forecast missed

Overlooking what was right in front of me

I ran down the road home
The pain I came to know that way
